rationale: Both are short and correct, with the same recite loop. A writes the two special verses out literally and uses one simple template for the general case, so each verse's shape is obvious at a glance. B removes more duplication, using capitalize() for the first line and an inline conditional for 'it'/'one'. However, it is half-generalised: the n == 0 verse still hardcodes 'no more bottles of beer' instead of reusing _bottles. It also packs the conditional and implicit string concatenation into one f-string expression, which is harder to scan. A is more readable, and B's extra cleverness brings little real benefit.
